description: While you were away (SPEC section 15): planAwayReplay, awaySenderLabel, the AwayController with a fake clock, a scripted client and a stub effect player, and the client calls. Format: conformance/README.md.

plan.name: worked example: build-up by units ascending, the large one last (design doc A.3)
budget 7000: the lowest-units non-large item goes first
budget 6000: items keep going, lowest units first, until the plan fits
an end exactly at the budget fits
two large groups: only the first (highest units) plays
all small: 450 ms apart, units ascending, equal units by gift id
maxEffects: only the first N groups in server order are considered
default maxEffects is 5: a sixth group is never planned
reduced motion: an empty plan (only the card shows)
low quality: the large effect lasts 3050 ms
a large group alone starts at 0
a lone large item longer than the budget goes too: empty plan
labels: a deleted sender uses labels.someone

controller.name: ackOn shown (default): idle -> loading -> ready -> playing -> done; one ack when the card appears; plays at the planned times; the card goes at planEnd + 1500
ackOn finished: the ack goes on dismiss (tap); plays not started yet are dropped
ackOn finished: the automatic dismissal acknowledges too
ackOn manual: nothing until ack(); a second ack() for the same summary sends nothing
a failed ack is reported, retried once before the next check's read, then dropped
a retried ack that succeeds is not sent a third time
nothing new: empty, no card, no ack; start() is ignored
check() is ignored while loading, ready or playing; it runs again from empty or done
a failed read goes back to idle silently (onError only); the next check tries again

error.message: Could not reach GiftingStack. Check your connection.

controller.name: foreground() checks at most once per 60,000 ms (60,000 itself checks)
no effect layer: card only, dismissed after 4000 ms
reduced motion: card only, dismissed after 4000 ms
maxGroups is passed to the read; maxEffects and budgetMs shape the replay
dismiss() before start(): done, acknowledged, nothing played
dispose() during the read: the late answer changes nothing

client.name: getAway without a query: no query string
getAway with since and maxGroups: since first, values encoded like encodeURIComponent
ackAway: PUT with the cursor, no Idempotency-Key; 204 is success with nothing parsed
ackAway: 500 then 204, one quiet retry like every call
ackAway: a bad cursor is a 400, not retried
